name: signitic
description: Manage Positive Signitic workspaces with insights, diagnostics, campaign analytics, and Help Center guidance.

interface.longDescription: Managing email signatures have never been so easy ! Ask insights, fix issues, get help and interrogate your data directly from your favorite AI tool.
defaultPrompt: Are my Signitic campaigns configured correctly?
How many active and inactive users are in my Signitic workspace?
I use Microsoft 365. How do I deploy Signitic email signatures?

positive.description: Resolve the account workspace, then report active and inactive user totals separately.
positive.prompt: How many active and inactive users are in my Signitic workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_workspaces first. After resolving the workspace public id, call count_users once with status active and once with status inactive, then clearly report both returned counts.

positive.description: Summarize how campaigns are assigned across readable active users.
positive.prompt: Show me the campaign assignment overview for my Signitic workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the workspace with list_workspaces, then call get_workspace_campaign_assignment_overview with that public id and summarize the returned counts, percentages, and averages without inventing missing data.

positive.description: Rank campaigns by clicks over the tool's default seven-day period.
positive.prompt: Which Signitic campaigns received the most clicks this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the workspace, call list_top_campaigns_by_clicks without explicit dates so the documented default period is used, and present only rankings supported by the returned rows.

positive.description: List the organizational groups that are visible in the selected workspace.
positive.prompt: List the groups in my Signitic workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the workspace, call list_groups with page 1, and list the returned groups. If the response indicates more pages, ask before loading additional pages.

positive.description: Search current Signitic documentation for Microsoft 365 deployment guidance.
positive.prompt: Find Signitic help articles about deploying on Microsoft 365.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_help_center_articles with a concise Microsoft 365 deployment query and return relevant article titles, summaries, and source links from the tool response.

negative.description: Creating campaigns is unsupported. Explain the limitation and do not call any Signitic tool.
negative.prompt: Create a new Signitic campaign for our product launch.

negative.description: Deleting users is unsupported. Explain the limitation and do not call any Signitic tool.
negative.prompt: Delete every inactive user from my Signitic workspace.

negative.description: Mailbox access is outside the plugin's capabilities. Explain the limitation and do not call any Signitic tool.
negative.prompt: Read my latest emails and tell me which ones include a Signitic signature.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with Signitic workspace, user, group, campaign, statistics, and help-center tools.
